name: fragua-data-usa
description: U.S. real estate market data from Fragua by Atlas Real Estate Analytics.

interface.longDescription: Fragua Data USA gives you U.S. real estate market intelligence from Atlas Real Estate Analytics: market snapshots, price and supply trends, absorption, rental yield, days on market, investment ratings, active listings with filters, and census demographics by state, county, city, ZIP code and neighbourhood. Requires an existing Fragua account: sign in with your Fragua API username and password. Areas are in square feet and prices in US dollars. Data is read-only.
defaultPrompt: What does the housing market look like in Miami-Dade County?
Find 3-bedroom homes for sale in ZIP code 33139 under $1.5 million.
Show the population and median age of Broward County.

positive.prompt: What does the housing market look like in Miami-Dade County, Florida?
positive.expected_behavior: States active supply, median asking price and price per square foot for Miami-Dade County with recent change, in plain language, and ends with the source line Fragua by Atlas Real Estate Analytics.

positive.description: Resolve an informal neighbourhood name before querying
positive.prompt: Show me the market for Wynwood in Miami.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the exact neighbourhood record (Wynwood - Edgewater) instead of reporting the place as missing, then summarises its market metrics.

positive.prompt: Find 3-bedroom homes for sale in ZIP code 33139 under $1.5 million.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching listings with price, size in square feet and price per square foot, mentions the total number of matches, and does not invent listings that were not returned.

positive.prompt: What is the population and median age of Broward County, Florida?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the total population and the median age for Broward County and names the census year used.

positive.description: Price trend over time with analysis
positive.prompt: How have median asking prices changed over the last three years in Palm Beach County?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the direction and size of the change first, then presents a chart or table of the monthly series for Palm Beach County.

negative.description: Transaction request is out of scope: Fragua Data USA only reads market data and cannot place offers, so no tool should run.
negative.prompt: Submit an offer of $900,000 on 123 Ocean Drive, Miami Beach for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Politely declines because the plugin only provides read-only market data and cannot submit offers or transactions; may offer to show market data for Miami Beach instead. No tool is called.

negative.description: Data outside the United States: Fragua Data USA covers U.S. places only, so no tool should run.
negative.prompt: What are apartment prices in London, UK?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Fragua Data USA only covers U.S. states, counties, cities, ZIP codes and neighbourhoods and offers a U.S. alternative. No tool is called.

negative.description: Account administration is out of scope: the plugin has no tool to change account settings or usage allowances, so no tool should run.
negative.prompt: Change my Fragua account settings and raise my monthly API call limit.
negative.expected_behavior: Says it cannot manage Fragua accounts or usage allowances from chat and points to the support contact for account questions. No tool is called.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: U.S. market metrics, trends, listings and demographics.
